name: Xiamen Voke Mold & Plastic Engineering Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Xiamen Voke Mold & Plastic Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of various injection molds in China and internationally. It provides car central housing control, car air outlet housing, grille, engine connection body, air outlet high-gloss panel, car button two-color mold, six fuel tank two-color housing, car panel housing, steering wheel airbag, car dashboard housing, automobile instrument internal structural parts housing, car glove box housing, and automobile electric tailgate spring sleeve, used in automotive field. It also provides electronic cigarette shell, pen cap, micro injection - hearing aid, optical cable communication shell, electronic connector, and 5G communication base station cooling fan products for use in electronic field; tool box, insulation box, multi-cavity cosmetic mold, baby carriage decorative cover shell, and baby wheel hub housing products used in home filed; and analysis box shell, medical laryngeal mask, medical oxygen mask, medical breathing ball, bed drive, and silicone oxygen mask for other markets. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Xiamen City, China.
